subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should OpenClaw add a Discord config surface for autoThread starter-versus-follow-up mention gating, and should it be a narrow `requireMentionInThreadReplies` option or part of a broader `thread.requireMention` design?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix changes a public Discord config/default surface and overlaps with a separate open Discord thread-specific mention configuration request.

options.title: Fold Into Thread Config
options.body: Use the broader Discord thread-specific config design as the canonical API and make the starter/follow-up autoThread behavior an explicit case under it.

options.title: Add Narrow AutoThread Option
options.body: Add a narrowly named option for auto-created thread follow-up gating while preserving existing thread override behavior separately.

options.title: Do Not Add Config
options.body: Keep current implicit autoThread continuity and document that there is no starter/follow-up middle ground.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Thread Config
recommendation.body: Use the broader Discord thread-specific config design as the canonical API and make the starter/follow-up autoThread behavior an explicit case under it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared mention-gating and recent Discord preflight history point to this owner as the best available API-direction reviewer.
